data.narrative:
GrayMatter Robotics is a Series B-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $70M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe comprising one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private companies operating in the same sector and stage, including Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

Two triangulation methods are applicable here. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the company's last known post-money valuation of $300M, yielding $570M. Peer-median analysis identifies three direct stage and sector comparables with valuations ranging from $1.6B to $2.0B; the median of this peer set is $1.8B. The peer-median method carries greater weight given the salience of direct market comps in this sector and stage.

The triangulated valuation range is $484M on the low end, $1.2B at the median, and $2.0B at the high end. This wide spread reflects material uncertainty between internal growth trajectory (stage-progression) and current market pricing for similar-stage robotics companies (peer-median). The $1.6B–$2.0B band derived from peer valuations represents the tightest confidence interval. Key uncertainties include the specificity of peer business models relative to GrayMatter's application focus, and whether recent market conditions have compressed or expanded valuations within the robotics sector since peer rounds closed.
